newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said on Thursday it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$3.00/cubic metre or C$0.48/barrel, to C$168.00/cubic metre or C$26.71/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:

Cromer light sour C$159.00/cubic metre, or C$25.28/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$130.00/cubic metre, or C$20.67/barrel Midale at Cromer C$145.00/cubic metre, or C$23.05/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
